title: Bilingual ANVISA Regulatory RAG Prototype
description: Unpublished bilingual retrieval-augmented generation prototype for article-level retrieval and cited question answering over selected public ANVISA regulatory documents. The repository includes code, benchmark artifacts, evaluation evidence, Streamlit demonstration documentation, and a source-document manifest with official ANVISA URLs and SHA-256 checksums. The full raw and cleaned ANVISA corpus is not redistributed.
